scenario.note: At most one of the years (1, 2, 3) has short-time workers above zero; this is enforced via logical rule with at least one condition holding.
A logical rule is applied to the overmanned workers at unskilled level in year 1, requiring at least 860 overmanned workers if any retraining occurs to a higher skill level in year 1.
